trigger.raw_text: Customer navigates to a Category 'Browse' Page or Search Result Page.

claims.content: Customer navigates to a Category 'Browse' Page or Search Result Page.

System displays list of products with sortable column headers including Action, Image, Product ID, Auction #, Description, Opens, Bid, High Bid, Unit Cost ($), Starts, Ends, Duration, Product Type, and Increment.
Customer may sort the product list by clicking on underlined column headers.
Customer may apply filters using the 'Filters On / Off' checkbox to refine search results.
System indicates which auctions are scheduled (not currently live) via blue-highlighted rows.
Customer selects one or more items via checkboxes in the 'Action' column.
Customer chooses an action from the dropdown menu (e.g., 'Remove Checked Items from Auction', 'Edit Reserve Amounts', etc.).
Customer optionally applies a profile to selected items via the 'Apply Profile to Selected Items' dropdown.
Customer clicks 'Apply Changes' button to execute selected actions on checked items.
Customer may toggle thumbnail images on/off via checkbox above search results to enable/disable visual previews in the product list.
Customer may rearrange item attribute columns from their default display order using column reordering functionality (similar to Excel’s autofilter).
Customer may filter search results by entering partial matches with wildcards (* or %) for Product ID (SKU number).

Customer may filter by customer (participant) email address, scheduled start/end date, cost range (low/high), product type (via scrolling list box), auction duration (via scrolling list box), or make multiple selections using Control key.
If the user is not signed in and clicks the QuickBid button, the system prompts the user to sign in; after completing the sign-in process, the user is delivered to the Product Details page.
Closed items (items that are closed) will be removed within 1 minute or whatever interval, as chosen in the global settings by the 'Auctioneer'.
No product will ever be eligible to appear on a product details page, search results, or catalog page if it does not have an available image to display.
The system displays the updated list of products reflecting any applied filters, sorts, or actions (e.g., removal, profile application) executed by the Customer.

Selected items have had the chosen action (e.g., 'Remove Checked Items from Auction', 'Edit Reserve Amounts') applied to them as specified by the Customer’s dropdown selection and confirmed via 'Apply Changes'.
If a profile was selected and applied, the associated attribute modifications are persisted to the selected items’ records in the system.
Thumbnail images remain toggled on or off according to the Customer’s last setting if that option was used during browsing.
Column display order reflects any reordering performed by the Customer using the column reordering functionality.
